 Titans DE Jaylen Harrell is hospitalized after “serious car accident”
 By
 Mike Florio , 
 By
 Mike Florio 
     Published November 21, 2026 12:53 PM 
 Add 
 on Google 
 Facebook 
 Twitter 
 Email
 Add 
 on Google 
 Titans defensive end Jaylen Harrell has been involved in a “serious car accident.” The team disclosed the situation on Saturday.
 Per the Titans, Harrell was taken to a hospital in his hometown of Tampa.
 “We have been in constant communication with Jaylen’s family and are still working to gather more information,” the Titans said, via Turron Davenport of ESPN. “At this time, Jaylen remains in the hospital and continues to receive care. We ask that Jaylen and his family’s privacy be respected at this time. We will provide an update when appropriate.”
 Harrell, 24, was a seventh-round draft pick in 2024. He played college football at Michigan.
 Currently on injured reserve, Harrell appeared in all 17 games during the 2024 and 2025 seasons.
